svg.title: Blue Diagonal
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. White rear panel retained. Oblique photograph has been schematically flattened. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
